candidates.title: NHTSA formally orders Tesla to prove Cybercab is legal to sell — under oath, by Sept 30
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Escalation from AQ26002 (opened Sep 3) to a sworn Special Order: 21 requests, $139M penalty ceiling, potential criminal liability; NHTSA specifically asks how Cybercab is legal to sell without a Part 555 FMVSS exemption — the same path Zoox took and Tesla deliberately skipped. Determines whether commercial Cybercab service can continue to scale.

candidates.title: Tesla Cybercab turns 10-minute Austin trip into 70-minute detour — no highways, no railroad crossings
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Surface-street-only limitation combined with at-grade railroad-crossing avoidance forces massive detours across all Austin robotaxi vehicles (Cybercab + Model Y fleet). App shows price but not trip-time estimates, so riders discover the detour only mid-ride. Waymo already allows highway driving in some cities, underlining a competitive gap.

candidates.title: Tesla Robotaxis to get FSD v15 and start 24/7 rides 'next month,' Elluswamy confirms
candidates.whyItMightMatter: VP of AI Elluswamy confirms October fleet-wide v15 rollout to enable 24/7 commercial operations. v15 (10B-parameter network) is also the prerequisite Tesla has named for multi-city Robotaxi expansion. Article synthesises fleet-validation implications for consumer HW4 rollout timeline late 2026 / early 2027.

candidates.title: Samsung starts trial production of Tesla AI5 chips on 2nm process at Taylor, Texas fab
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Samsung pulled forward Taylor fab startup from November to begin yield verification on the $16.5B AI5 chip contract. Some production lines are already making AI5 wafers; mass-production verification targeted for year-end, full supply to Tesla in 2027. Directly affects Cybercab, Optimus, and FSD computer supply timelines.

candidates.title: Terafab is Taiwan chip insurance, Musk says at All-In Summit — 'build it or fail to scale'
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Musk's clearest public strategic framing of Terafab as geopolitical necessity rather than ambition: Taiwan supply risk + global fab capacity gap forces in-house production. Confirms crawl-walk-run path: Austin R&D fab by end of 2027, then Grimes County scale. All-In Summit Sept 13-15 LA.

candidates.title: Tesla and SpaceX sue nanotechnology firm TERA-print to secure 'Terafab' trademark
candidates.whyItMightMatter: TERA-print sent a cease-and-desist over its existing 'Tera-Fab' mark; Tesla and SpaceX responded with a federal complaint in Austin. Legal cloud over the brand name adds friction to the $16.8B project's permitting and public communications track.

candidates.title: Tesla Semi makes European public debut at IAA Hannover; Semi Charging for Business opens in 5 EU markets
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First public showing of EU-homologated Semi (800V, 550 km at 40t, up to 800 kW charging); ride-alongs at show Sept 15-20; Megacharger + Basecharger depot sales open in DE, NL, BE, FR, UK. Deliveries start 2027. No Long Range announced for Europe; positions Tesla Semi in a market dominated by Volvo FH Electric.

candidates.title: Tesla deploys first pre-assembled 1.2 MW Megachargers for Semi production ramp
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First factory-pre-assembled V4 Megacharger units (dual posts, 1.2 MW each) now in the field; invite-only Semi rollout at Sparks factory set for Sept 24. Charging infrastructure deployment is the critical bottleneck for fleet electrification ahead of Semi deliveries accelerating.

candidates.title: Optimus supply chain orders signal 15,000 units by year-end; 1,000/week by end of September
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Component orders reviewed by industry trackers confirm 15,000-unit target in 2026, ramping from ~1,000/week in late September to ~2,500/week by December — implying a 100,000-125,000 annualised run rate entering 2027. First outside-customer commercial shipments still slated for 2027; all 2026 units go to internal Tesla factory deployment.

candidates.title: Tesla Roadster production reveal confirmed for October 1 in Waco, Texas
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First hard date for Roadster production reveal after nine years of delays; countdown timer live on Tesla website; reservation-holder invitations reference Waco TX venue and Sept 16 RSVP deadline. Marks transition from prototype to production reveal — but analysts note the SpaceX 'thruster package' framing may be tying Roadster timing to a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger narrative.

candidates.title: Tesla Roadster teaser hints at 'Cyber' redesign — full-width light bar and angular styling
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Weekend teaser suggests production Roadster inherits Cybertruck/Cybercab angular 'Cyber' aesthetic with full-width light bar, departing from the 2017 concept's curves. Electrek critical: original design had stronger appeal; changes risk alienating reservation holders who already waited 8+ years. SpaceX cold-gas thruster package headline feature.
